name: Chemp Tag!
summary: Chemp Tag has anything you can imagine! You can play the gamemodes like horror, speeding wall, low gravity, hangout, and more! There are a few maps for you and your best buddies to hang out in, and to play your own games. There is a fanart room to check out all the best art by the members inside of Chemp Tags Discord community. I hope you have fun playing Chemp Tag!
